# Outcomes

This engagement will equip PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC with actionable, automated insights into every stage of its client acquisition pipeline, empowering leadership to make data-driven decisions on marketing effectiveness and operational growth. By delivering enhanced Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting, PURE will gain precise visibility into conversion metrics and marketing ROI. Success will be measured by the accuracy, integration, and automation of reporting, as well as improved granularity in pipeline performance analysis.

## Expected Business Outcomes

- **Actionable Pipeline Insights:** Leadership and stakeholders will have access to granular Lead-to-AUM metrics, enabling focused improvement across critical touchpoints of the client acquisition journey.
- **Optimized Marketing ROI:** Enhanced CAC reporting will illuminate the return on marketing spend, supporting smarter allocation of resources for acquisition campaigns and investments.
- **Automated Reporting Processes:** The ingestion, transformation, and refresh of data will be fully automated, reducing manual intervention and increasing efficiency for data, technology, and marketing teams.
- **Integrated Data Ecosystem:** Seamless integration of Salesforce, QuickBooks, Tamarac, and Azure Fabric ensures that all relevant data supports unified and accurate reporting, minimizing gaps and maximizing reliability.
- **Scalable Analytics Framework:** The solution lays the groundwork for future integration of additional data sources and expanded reporting needs, strengthening PURE’s data maturity and supporting its long-term growth objectives.
- **Clear KPI Visualization:** Improved Power BI dashboards will provide intuitive visibility into conversion rates and CAC metrics, enabling senior leadership and marketing teams to drive strategic decisions with confidence.

These outcomes directly address PURE’s current pain points—limited reporting granularity and fragmented CAC insights—and define clear success metrics, such as automated and accurate L2A and CAC reporting, as well as measurable improvement in marketing and pipeline visibility.
